items.title: Texas Instruments (TXN), Why Is The Chipmaker Back In The Spotlight?
items.summary: Texas Instruments (TXN) is back on investors’ radar after a 3.3% share price drop, tied to surging crude oil prices and higher Treasury yields, which have raised concerns about inflation and borrowing costs.
